CARD_PREVIEW_IN_CREATE = true in picker.html. Rubric cover PNG/HTML previews return on #/content/create. Pictures step preview stays archived (CARD_PREVIEW_IN_PICTURES = false).
Rubric covers on Create and slide preview column on Pictures are hidden. Flags CARD_PREVIEW_IN_CREATE / CARD_PREVIEW_IN_PICTURES in picker.html.
After text generation, preview skips stale DOM collect so server-written slide texts appear immediately.
Pictures and emoji generation use fal-ai/nano-banana-2 at 1K (4:5 for slides, 1:1 for emoji). FAL_MODEL default updated.
Hello-slide preview uses emoji-specific layouts (bottom-weighted), resolves emoji from Settings, and matches export positioning.
Systems → Changelog reads data/changelog.json. Technical site changes are versioned here (like GitHub releases).
New rubric with a single Settings step: enter subject, generate flat emoji, save PNG to ALL EMOJIS.
Preview and export share one resolver. Hello slide: item = 2nd swatch; fact slides: body = 2nd, headers = 3rd.
Explicit colorStyleId wins over stale card background so swatches no longer jump back after save.
Export auto-generates missing texts; per-slide progress persisted; Traefik timeout labels removed (broke routing).
Brand / Home / Content / Systems / Site top nav; content subnav and tree; hash routes for all sections.
Upload or pick from post assets; workflow survives slide switches.
saveAllTexts no longer overwrites cards; flush before re-render.
